_note: Organisational policy (hand-made by design: it is a rule set, not a retrievable fact). Protected assets were derived from the data: the two hosts receiving almost all DNS (port 53) flows in CIC-IDS2017.

block_ip.description: Block an IP address at the perimeter firewall

block_domain.description: Block or sinkhole a domain at the DNS resolver

open_ticket.description: Open a ticket for follow-up by a human

enable_waf_rule.description: Enable a web application firewall rule set

force_password_reset.description: Force a password reset and revoke sessions for a user

isolate_host.description: Quarantine a host from the network
